cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: I Know How to Win This
cards.instruction: Perform mastery of the rules, odds, and consequences while improvising every decision.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've folded my ticket into quarters like you. Much better odds that way.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm folding the numbered stubs for the drum. Your ticket stays with you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Precisely. A compact record of my entry. Which number are you putting in?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The same number as yours. Keep yours flat so we can match them if you win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Flat it is. No risk of a winning number getting lost in a crease.

reason: Replace the unsupported confidence overlay with a concrete misunderstood copied action that directs the same-holder Drive pursuit, with a responsive partner and an ending using B4.
